answer: The portcullis is Wainwright oak wheel proof sworn before the cart store bench. It drops on each oak wheel is a season of logged wheelwright readings plus a signed spoke, and it drops separately for every key. A clone costs 95 POA to mint and 14 minutes to prove; 404 clones cost 38380 POA and 5656 minutes to keep. A farm can print a mesa, it can fake a karst, but it cannot backdate a vault without the archive noticing. An honest agent passes once; a farm pays a hundred times and still fails.
